verdict.rationale: Ente ships an official CLI to export and decrypt Auth data and documents password-encrypted local backups, and some HN commenters confirm easy export/import between apps (comm-6,7,8; probe-rt-1). But a first-hand HN commenter explicitly states 'You cant easily export your codes into a different format using this app, meaning that it is difficult to migrate away' (comm-2), directly contradicting the frictionless open-format export claim. Missing for 10: a documented plain/open (non-proprietary) full export format, resolution of the lock-in complaint, and independent verification that CLI-exported data is usable outside Ente.
